caption:
Cost per lead feels fine. Cost per booked job moves your profit.

Two shops can spend identical ad budgets, generate identical leads, and end the month in different places. The gap comes down to one thing: how fast and how well they close.

The Ad ROI Calculator takes three numbers you already have, ad spend, leads generated, close rate, and returns one number: your true cost per booked job.

Run it twice. Once with your current close rate. Once assuming every lead gets answered in under five minutes. Industry data ties fast response to higher close rates. Run the numbers and see the shift in your cost per job.

Free. No card. Under a minute.
